note_en: Swiss is done: GEN and DK went 3-0; IG, T1 and TES 3-1; BLG, KC and LYON 3-2. GEN remain clear title favourites at 44.8%. The model and market split hardest on T1 (8.0% vs 21.1%) and TES (11.4% vs 2.9%). TES–IG opens the quarterfinals on 3 November.
note_zh: 瑞士轮结束：GEN、DK 3-0，IG、T1、TES 3-1，BLG、KC、LYON 3-2 晋级。GEN 以 44.8% 稳居夺冠热门；模型与市场分歧最大在 T1（8.0% 对 21.1%）和 TES（11.4% 对 2.9%）。11 月 3 日 TES 对 IG 揭开八强战。

series.reason_en: Elimination Bo3 between two 0-2 sides. The model and Polymarket (72.5%) both favour AL; no roster news changes the read.
series.reason_zh: 两支 0-2 队伍的淘汰 Bo3。模型与 Polymarket（72.5%）都看好 AL，暂无影响判断的阵容消息。
factors_en: Fearless: both pools sit at depth 30; AL's Nocturne (89% presence, 78% win rate) will likely be banned or burned early.
Market prices AL at 72.5% versus the model's 67.1%, so the blend leans away from TL.
Both teams are 0-2, so the loser is out of Worlds.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：双方英雄池深度均为 30；AL 的梦魇登场率 89%、胜率 78%，大概率被早禁或早用。
市场给 AL 72.5%，高于模型 67.1%，融合后更偏离 TL。
双方均 0-2，败者直接出局。

series.reason_en: Another 0-2 elimination Bo3. TSW is favoured at 63% (market 65.5%), with a 0-2 sweep the single most likely scoreline.
series.reason_zh: 又一场 0-2 淘汰 Bo3。TSW 胜率 63%（市场 65.5%），最可能比分为 0-2。
factors_en: Fearless: TSW has shown Ezreal, Qiyana and Rumble, all top-12 meta picks, giving it more flex options in games 2-3.
LOS's played pool leans on Syndra, Nocturne and Orianna, which are heavily contested and often banned.
The market (65.5%) and the model (63%) agree within three points.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：TSW 已用过伊泽瑞尔、奇亚娜、兰博等 meta 前 12 英雄，第二、三局可选面更宽。
LOS 已用英雄集中在辛德拉、梦魇、奥莉安娜，均为高争夺、常被禁用的位置。
市场 65.5% 与模型 63% 相差不足 3 个百分点。

series.reason_en: Bo1 at 1-1. BLG is favoured at 71.7%, and the market (70.5%) almost exactly agrees.
series.reason_zh: 1-1 组的 Bo1。BLG 胜率 71.7%，市场 70.5%，几乎一致。
factors_en: Fearless: KC has the shallowest pool at the event (depth 28) and leans on Kalista/Renata and Cassiopeia.
BLG's played pool (Akali, Orianna, Lee Sin, Nautilus) overlaps with high-presence meta picks.
Model and market are within 1.2 points, so the line is stable.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：KC 英雄池深度 28，全场最浅，依赖卡莉丝塔/芮娜塔与卡西奥佩娅。
BLG 已用阿卡丽、奥莉安娜、李青、诺提勒斯，与高登场率 meta 重合。
模型与市场相差仅 1.2 个百分点，盘面稳定。

series.reason_en: Bo1 at 1-1. The model has T1 at 75.6%; the market is more confident at 88.5%. One game means high variance.
series.reason_zh: 1-1 组的 Bo1。模型给 T1 75.6%，市场更乐观（88.5%）。单局定胜负，波动大。
factors_en: Fearless: in a Bo1 nothing carries over, so T1's depth of 29 versus CFO's 30 matters little; only bans shape the draft.
Vi, which T1 has played, has 91% presence but a 25% win rate. Whether T1 picks it again is a draft tell.
Market and model differ by 13 points, the widest gap among today's open series.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：Bo1 不存在跨局消耗，T1 深度 29 与 CFO 30 差异不大，仅禁用影响选人。
T1 用过的蔚登场率 91% 但胜率仅 25%，是否再拿是征召看点。
市场与模型相差 13 个百分点，为今日未开赛场次中分歧最大。

series.reason_en: The closest quarterfinal on paper. The model makes TES a slight 51.0% favourite on Elo; the market leans IG at 56.5%. Both went 3-1 in Swiss, so the pick is a near coin flip with TES 3-1 as the single likeliest score.
series.reason_zh: 纸面上最接近的一场八强。模型按 Elo 给 TES 51.0% 微弱优势，市场则偏向 IG（56.5%）。两队瑞士轮均为 3-1，本场近乎五五开，最可能比分 TES 3-1。
factors_en: Fearless: both teams have shown 16 unique champions, depth 36 each, so neither side runs out of comfort picks before a game five.
IG lead every team on GD@15 (1613, top percentile); TES are bottom on first blood (16.7%), so IG should own the early game.
TES close better late: Baron control 66.7% versus IG's 37.5%, which keeps TES alive if games go long.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：两队都已用出 16 个不同英雄，深度均为 36，打到第五局前都不缺舒适英雄。
IG 的 15 分钟经济差 1613 全赛最高；TES 一血率仅 16.7% 垫底，前期 IG 占优。
TES 后期更稳：大龙控制率 66.7%，IG 仅 37.5%，拖到后期 TES 有翻盘空间。

series.reason_en: GEN went 3-0 and already beat LYON 2-1 in round three; the model gives GEN 88.1% and the market 92.5%. LYON scraped through at 3-2 with the worst early game of the eight (GD@15 −867), so 3-0 is the likeliest single score.
series.reason_zh: GEN 瑞士轮 3-0，且第三轮已 2-1 击败 LYON；模型给 GEN 88.1%，市场 92.5%。LYON 以 3-2 惊险晋级，15 分钟经济差 −867 为八强最差，最可能比分 3-0。
factors_en: Fearless: LYON have the deeper shown pool (19 unique champions, depth 39 vs GEN's 32), their one real edge if the series stretches.
Canyon leads GEN with 10.5 KDA and +627 GD@15; LYON's best player Berserker sits at −363 GD@15.
GEN take 80% of dragons, the best rate in the event, while LYON trail at −867 gold by 15 minutes.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：LYON 已展示 19 个不同英雄，深度 39 高于 GEN 的 32，系列赛拉长时是其唯一优势。
Canyon KDA 10.5、15 分钟经济差 +627；LYON 最佳选手 Berserker 15 分钟仍落后 363。
GEN 小龙控制率 80% 全赛第一，LYON 15 分钟平均落后 867 经济。

series.reason_en: Model and market agree almost exactly: BLG 59.7% vs 59.5%. DK went 3-0 but BLG's Elo is higher after beating KC and HLE to qualify at 3-2. The likeliest score is BLG 3-1.
series.reason_zh: 模型与市场几乎一致：BLG 59.7%，市场 59.5%。DK 瑞士轮 3-0，但 BLG 击败 KC、HLE 以 3-2 晋级后 Elo 更高。最可能比分 BLG 3-1。
factors_en: Fearless: dead level on depth (35 each, 15 unique champions shown), so draft attrition should not decide this series.
Mid matchup headliner: ShowMaker 9.0 KDA, +389 GD@15 against Knight 8.4 KDA, +412 GD@15.
BLG get first blood 87.5% of the time; DK are better at first tower (75%), so DK must survive the opening skirmishes.
factors_zh: 无畏征召：两队深度同为 35、各展示 15 个英雄，英雄消耗不会成为胜负手。
中路焦点：ShowMaker KDA 9.0、15 分钟 +389，对位 Knight KDA 8.4、+412。
BLG 一血率 87.5%；DK 一塔率 75% 更高，DK 需扛住开局小规模团战。

series.reason_en: T1 are clear favourites: 73.7% in the model, 82.5% on the market. KC qualified at 3-2; T1 at 3-1 after a clean 2-0 over MKOI. The model is kinder to KC than the market, and T1 3-1 is its likeliest score.
series.reason_zh: T1 明显占优：模型 73.7%，市场 82.5%。KC 以 3-2 晋级；T1 3-1 晋级并 2-0 横扫 MKOI。模型对 KC 比市场更宽容，最可能比分 T1 3-1。
factors_en: Fearless: KC have shown 19 unique champions (depth 39) to T1's 15 (35), the widest pool among the eight, which helps in games four and five.
Doran leads T1 at 7.8 KDA and 700 DPM; KC's Caliste deals 763 DPM but trails −147 gold at 15.
T1 take first tower 80% of the time; KC answer through dragons (64.5%).
factors_zh: 无畏征召：KC 已展示 19 个不同英雄（深度 39），T1 为 15 个（35），KC 英雄池八强最宽，利于第四、五局。
Doran KDA 7.8、分均伤害 700 领跑 T1；KC 的 Caliste 分均伤害 763，但 15 分钟落后 147。
T1 一塔率 80%；KC 以 64.5% 小龙控制率回应。

champion.reason_en: 44.8% (implied 2.23) matches the 44.6% market almost exactly. GEN are the only 3-0 team with a soft quarterfinal (88.1% vs LYON) and 80% dragon control; the path still runs through a likely semifinal against the TES/IG winner.
champion.reason_zh: 44.8%（隐含赔率 2.23）与市场 44.6% 几乎一致。GEN 是 3-0 晋级且八强对手最弱（对 LYON 胜率 88.1%）的队伍，小龙控制率 80%；半决赛大概率面对 TES/IG 胜者。

champion.reason_en: 19.4% (implied 5.15) sits above the 14.6% market. BLG are 59.7% to beat DK and have the strongest Elo of the bottom half; Knight and an 87.5% first-blood rate drive it. A semifinal with T1 or KC is likely.
champion.reason_zh: 19.4%（隐含 5.15）高于市场 14.6%。BLG 对 DK 胜率 59.7%，下半区 Elo 最高；Knight 与 87.5% 一血率是关键，半决赛大概率遇 T1 或 KC。

champion.reason_en: 11.4% (implied 8.77) is far above the 2.9% market. The model only sees a coin-flip quarterfinal with IG (51.0%) and TES's Elo; the market appears to price their weak 16.7% first-blood rate and a GEN semifinal more harshly.
champion.reason_zh: 11.4%（隐含 8.77）远高于市场 2.9%。模型只看到对 IG 五五开（51.0%）和 TES 的 Elo；市场似乎更重视其 16.7% 一血率和半决赛对 GEN 的劣势。

champion.reason_en: 8.4% (implied 11.9) vs 7.6% on the market. A 3-0 Swiss run, but only 40.3% against BLG, and ShowMaker's 9.0 KDA has to carry them past T1 or KC afterwards.
champion.reason_zh: 8.4%（隐含 11.9），市场 7.6%。瑞士轮 3-0，但对 BLG 胜率仅 40.3%，之后还需 ShowMaker（KDA 9.0）带队越过 T1 或 KC。

champion.reason_en: 8.0% (implied 12.5) is well below the 21.1% market, the biggest gap on the board. The model rates T1 73.7% over KC but then makes them underdogs to BLG on Elo; the market trusts T1's Worlds pedigree, which the model ignores.
champion.reason_zh: 8.0%（隐含 12.5）远低于市场 21.1%，是全表最大分歧。模型给 T1 对 KC 73.7%，但按 Elo 半决赛不敌 BLG；市场看重 T1 的世界赛底蕴，模型不计入。

champion.reason_en: 6.6% (implied 15.15) equals the 6.6% market. IG are 49.0% against TES with the event's best GD@15 (1613) but weak Baron control (37.5%), and a GEN semifinal likely awaits.
champion.reason_zh: 6.6%（隐含 15.15）与市场 6.6% 一致。IG 对 TES 胜率 49.0%，15 分钟经济差 1613 全赛最高，但大龙控制率仅 37.5%，半决赛大概率遇 GEN。

champion.reason_en: 0.8% (implied 125) vs 1.5% on the market. A 3-2 qualifier at 26.3% against T1, then BLG or DK; the deepest Fearless pool (39) is not enough to offset the Elo gap.
champion.reason_zh: 0.8%（隐含 125），市场 1.5%。3-2 晋级，对 T1 胜率 26.3%，之后还要过 BLG 或 DK；无畏深度 39 全队最深，仍不足以弥补 Elo 差距。

champion.reason_en: 0.6% (implied 166.67) vs 1.1% on the market. LYON already lost to GEN in round three and are 11.9% to win the rematch, with a −867 GD@15 the worst among the eight.
champion.reason_zh: 0.6%（隐含 166.67），市场 1.1%。LYON 第三轮已负于 GEN，此番复仇胜率 11.9%，15 分钟经济差 −867 为八强最差。

mvp.basis_en: 23.3% (implied 4.29): MVP odds follow title odds, and GEN lead at 44.8%. Ruler gets the largest share of GEN's weight as the carry role.
mvp.basis_zh: 23.3%（隐含 4.29）：MVP 概率跟随夺冠概率，GEN 以 44.8% 领先，Ruler 作为核心输出位占 GEN 权重最大。

mvp.basis_en: 20.6% (implied 4.85): GEN's best player by the numbers at 10.5 KDA, 79.9% KP and +627 GD@15.
mvp.basis_zh: 20.6%（隐含 4.85）：数据上 GEN 最佳选手，KDA 10.5、参团率 79.9%、15 分钟经济差 +627。

mvp.basis_en: 20.2% (implied 4.95): carried by GEN's title odds despite the team's lowest in-role score (5.1 KDA, −350 GD@15).
mvp.basis_zh: 20.2%（隐含 4.95）：受 GEN 夺冠概率带动，尽管本届队内同位置评分最低（KDA 5.1、15 分钟 −350）。

mvp.basis_en: 14.4% (implied 6.94): BLG's best player (8.4 KDA, +412 GD@15) on the second-favourite team at 19.4%.
mvp.basis_zh: 14.4%（隐含 6.94）：BLG 最佳选手（KDA 8.4、15 分钟 +412），所在队夺冠概率 19.4% 排第二。

mvp.basis_en: 12.9% (implied 7.75): a top laner's share of GEN's 44.8% title chance.
mvp.basis_zh: 12.9%（隐含 7.75）：作为上单分得 GEN 44.8% 夺冠概率中的一份。

mvp.basis_en: 8.6% (implied 11.63): BLG's carry role keeps him on the board despite −463 GD@15 so far.
mvp.basis_zh: 8.6%（隐含 11.63）：BLG 核心输出位，尽管目前 15 分钟落后 463 仍在榜上。

notes: semifinal halves assumed QF1/QF2 and QF3/QF4 winners
model: Draft data covers only game 1 of each Swiss Bo3 (gol.gg match rows link the opening game), so Fearless depth undercounts champions used in games 2-3.
model: Fable sealed no picks for rounds 4-5: the daily run did not publish between 2026-10-27 and 2026-10-31.
model: No confirmed roster or substitute news for the eight quarterfinalists was found; all adjustments are 0.
model: Semifinal halves are not confirmed by the sources reached; the title sim assumes QF1/QF2 and QF3/QF4 winners meet.
